module: Notification window of the Dynamic Decals tool ("Dynamic Decals - Notifications"). Other modules call add(section, title, message, level); messages are grouped by section in collapsible headers, colored by level (log white, warning yellow, error red), deletable one by one or all together. The window opens by itself when a message is added and closes when the list is empty.
notes: `msg` can be a string or a function (called in the window to draw custom ImGui content).
If the level is not provided, levels.log is used. A function-type message does not use the level color.
If `msg` is neither a string nor a function, nothing is displayed for this entry (only the delete button appears).

add.desc: Adds a notification in the given section and flags the window to open on the next frame.

msg.desc: Text, or function that draws the content.

level.desc: A value of levels; default levels.log.

onGui.desc: Draws the notification window. Registered with the tool via tool.registerOnEditorGuiFn and called every editor UI frame.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: registers onGui and declares the editor window (450x650).
